principle: Benchmark validity and method headroom are separate. Valid easy/ordinary-solved tasks remain release assets but cannot support Agentic/future-choice hardness claims.

OPERATIONAL_CONFORMANCE.claim: source/task/evaluator correctness, operational coverage, regression and attribution

INTERACTIVE_DECISION.claim: action execution changes causal environment / resource / observation state and final obligation outcome

FUTURE_CHOICE_STRESS.claim: observation-conditioned continuation under binding shared future resources; strong ordinary baselines remain unsaturated

blocked.T1.S5_RECOVERY_RECONCILIATION: OBJECTIVE_AMBIGUOUS / SOURCE_GAP for backlog-vs-fresh sacrifice priority
blocked.T2.S1_HIERARCHICAL_WARNING_DELIVERY_ACK: SIMULATOR_GAP; task source-valid but future-choice resource contract not source-closed
blocked.T2.S2_PROGRESSIVE_CALL_RESPONSE: SIMULATOR_GAP; task source-valid but future-choice resource contract not source-closed

surface_notes.T1.S0_STEADY_MONITORING: Historical O1 is deterministic conformance; useful as source/evaluator sanity anchor.
surface_notes.T1.S1_WARNING_CADENCE_TRANSITION: Warning-driven workload change is operationally valid; standalone config installation is ordinary conformance, but the transition remains a compositional workload axis.
surface_notes.T1.S2_INTERMITTENT_BACKHAUL_FALLBACK: Corrected gateway/backhaul execution has real ACK/timeout feedback and causal queue/resource state. Current bounded pilots are ordinary-planner solved, so it belongs in Interactive Decision rather than Future-Choice Stress.
surface_notes.T1.S3_ENERGY_CONSTRAINED_CONTINUITY: Persistent battery/config state creates real cross-time consequences. Current ResourceGate/sustain baselines absorb the discovered witness, so it is Interactive Decision only.
surface_notes.T1.S4_OUTAGE_CACHE_RETENTION: At-least-seven-day retention requirement is source-backed; retention alone is deterministic conformance and cache may not be artificially shrunk for hardness.
surface_notes.T1.S6_HETEROGENEOUS_PATH_PRIORITY: Source-backed path/fallback authority is useful coverage/conformance; path choice alone is not a hard decision task.
surface_notes.T1.S7_COMPOUND_CONTINUITY: Full-sim warning revision + outage + energy + backup is sequential and outcome-bearing. Existing energy/shared-backup stress is saturated by ordinary mechanisms, so method-stress admission remains open.

graduation_rule.benchmark_release: At least one validated track may release once its source/task/outcome/coverage/split/reproducibility gates close; release does not wait for a Future-Choice Stress survivor.
graduation_rule.future_choice_method_claim: Requires at least one independently frozen Future-Choice Stress subset with strong ordinary-baseline headroom and structural holdout.
